svg.aria-label: Unipolar SPWM: the carrier compared with the reference and its inverse drives each leg separately, and the difference is a three-level output whose pulses repeat at twice the carrier frequency
svg.text: Unipolar SPWM: two references 180° apart, one carrier, a three-level output

text.tspan: Leg and line voltages vs. t — the difference of two legs switches between three levels
